text:
Sam: FYI vendor uploaded the SKU migration spreadsheet. tl;dr — migration fee + tiered spot repricing. Need inputs for the cost model ASAP.
Maria: can you paste the key numbers here? finance needs per-SKU effective unit cost (reserved vs spot) after migration fee amortization.
Sam: sure. main points from the sheet:
- migration_fee_usd: 50k one-time per partner
- repricing_tiers: 0-10k hrs -> -5% spot discount, 10k-50k -> -10%, 50k+ -> -18%
- phased-grandfather: 90d for existing reserved pricing if we sign addendum
Alex: quick product ask — does repricing change latency premium or routing policy? We need to know if we should keep a reserve fallback for high-p99 paths.
Jordan: ops note — if we move SKUs to marketplace, eviction delta observed on similar vendors: +2.5% monthly on spot. reserved holdback failures ~0.8%.
Maria: proposed finance treatment: amortize migration_fee over 12 months, add 10% contingency to spot cost for variability. sample calc for sku-rtx-a:
```
base_spot = $0.35/hr
migration_alloc = 50000/12 / (est_hours_per_month)
adjusted_spot = base_spot * (1 + 0.10) + migration_alloc
```
Sam: @VendorBot said they updated the listing with tier matrix and a CSV link: https://vendor.example.com/migration/sku-tiers.csv
VendorBot: Uploaded CSV v3 — includes sku_id, base_reserved_usd, base_spot_usd, expected_monthly_hours, repricing_tier.
Alex: marketing/announce coordination: if we accept the 90d grandfather, product and comms need 2 weeks to update docs and FAQ. can we get legal review for the addendum timeline?
Maria: legal review estimate: 3 business days if we push a clean addendum. i'll queue it but need final decision by EOD Friday.
Jordan: SI partners (BlueWave / Satcom) will need a SKU mapping. they asked about migration windows and whether spots will be labeled differently in our API (we should keep API sku_id stable).
Sam: action items:
- Sam: confirm migration numbers with vendor + ask if they’ll split migration_fee (partner credit) or invoice directly
- Maria: run per-SKU amortized cost table and sensitivity (+5%, +10% spot volatility)
- Alex: draft canary/routing policy for p99 traffic to keep on reserved pool during first 30d post-migration
- Jordan: get eviction telemetry baseline for the SKUs (last 6 months)
VendorBot: Noted. Vendor asked whether Redwood will offer a short-term reserve top-up discount to smooth the migration. They proposed a 20% discount on first-month reserved purchases if booked within 14 days.
Maria: that promo would materially reduce migration churn risk. modeled it quickly: if 20% off first month for new reserved converts, payback on migration_fee moves from 8 months -> ~5.2 months for high-util SKUs.
Alex: we should also include a comms cadence for partners: pre-migration notice (30d), opt-in window (14d), post-migration telemetry check (30d).
Sam: ok i'll push the questions to vendor: split fee? promo opt-in? final csv with mapping. will update here once vendor responds. :thumbsup:
